## About the Company
Ark Roofing & Renovations LLC has protected Tacoma-area homes and businesses for over 23 years. Founded by Wil Letourneau, the company started as a focused roofing operation and grew into a full-service exterior and interior renovation contractor. From roof replacements and siding installations to deck builds, fence work, gutter systems, and interior remodeling, Ark handles projects from foundation to ridgeline.

Wil and his crew bring hands-on experience to every job. They've torn off thousands of roofs, replaced rotted sheathing hidden behind failing siding, and rebuilt decks down to the footings. That kind of field knowledge means problems get caught early and fixed right — not patched over.

Ark Roofing & Renovations serves residential and commercial clients within a 50-mile radius of Tacoma. Whether it's storm damage that needs immediate attention or a planned renovation, the team delivers consistent craftsmanship backed by two decades of earned reputation.

## Services

### 1. Roofing
Full roof replacements, tear-offs, repairs, and storm damage restoration for residential and commercial properties. Ark has completed thousands of roofs across Pierce County. Services include removal of old shingles and underlayment, sheathing inspection and repair, ice and water shield installation, synthetic underlayment (APOC Gator-Skin), new flashing, ridge vent for ventilation, and asphalt shingle installation. Cost range: $8,000–$20,000 for standard residential. Timeline: 2–4 days.

### 2. Siding
Siding installation, replacement, and rot repair. Full removal of old siding, sheathing inspection, rotted OSB/plywood replacement, weather barrier (Jumbo Tex) installation, and new siding in vinyl, board-and-batten, or fiber cement. Cost range: $6,000–$18,000. Timeline: 3–7 days.

### 3. Decking
Custom deck builds from footings to finished railings. Includes demolition of old decks, concrete pier block foundations, pressure-treated lumber framing, decking and railing installation. Cost range: $5,000–$20,000. Timeline: 5–10 days.

### 4. Soffit & Fascia
Repair and replacement of soffit panels and fascia boards to protect the roofline from moisture and pest intrusion. Often discovered and addressed during roofing or siding projects. Cost range: $1,500–$6,000. Timeline: 1–3 days.

### 5. Fences
Wood, vinyl, and chain-link fence installation and repair. Cedar and pressure-treated options. All posts set in concrete footings at minimum 24-inch depth. Cost range: $2,500–$8,000. Timeline: 2–5 days.

### 6. Gutters
Seamless gutter installation, repair, and downspout routing. Critical for managing Tacoma's 38 inches of annual rainfall and protecting foundations. Cost range: $1,200–$4,500. Timeline: 1–2 days.

### 7. Roof Cleaning
Moss removal, soft washing, and debris clearing. Prevents shingle damage from Pacific Northwest moss and algae growth. Includes preventive zinc treatment. Cost range: $300–$800. Timeline: 3–6 hours.

### 8. Emergency Services
Rapid response for storm damage, fallen trees, active leaks, and wind damage. Emergency tarping and temporary repairs to stop water intrusion. Insurance claim documentation and coordination. Cost range: $500–$2,000 for emergency stabilization.

### 9. Flooring
Hardwood, laminate, vinyl plank, and tile installation. Includes old flooring removal, subfloor inspection and repair, and new installation. Cost range: $3–$12 per square foot. Timeline: 2–5 days.

### 10. Bathrooms
Full bathroom remodels including demolition, plumbing, tile, fixtures, vanities, and painting. Waterproofing with RedGard or Kerdi membrane. Cost range: $8,000–$25,000. Timeline: 2–4 weeks.

### 11. Drywall
New installation, repair, patching, water damage restoration, taping, mudding, and texture matching. Often follows water damage discovered during exterior work. Cost range: $200–$2,500 depending on scope. Timeline: 1–7 days.

### 12. Painting
Interior and exterior painting with proper prep, priming, and two-coat application. Uses premium paints rated for Pacific Northwest conditions. Cost range: Interior $1,500–$4,000/room; Exterior $3,000–$8,000. Timeline: 1–7 days.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How long does a roof replacement take in Tacoma?
A: Most residential roof replacements take 2–4 days depending on size, layers to tear off, and weather. Larger homes or jobs requiring sheathing replacement may take 3–5 days.

Q: Do you handle insurance claims for storm damage?
A: Yes. Ark works with insurance companies throughout the claims process, providing detailed damage assessments, photo documentation, and itemized repair estimates.

Q: What's included in a free estimate?
A: Full inspection, measurements, material recommendations, and a written quote with line-item pricing. For roofing, we check sheathing condition, flashing, vents, and gutters.

Q: Can you replace siding and roofing at the same time?
A: Yes, and it's often the smartest approach. Bundling saves 10–15% on combined projects and ensures the entire building envelope is sealed.

Q: Do you offer emergency roofing services?
A: Yes. Rapid response for storm damage, active leaks, and fallen trees. Call (253) 777-9683 for emergency service.

Q: How often should I clean my roof in Tacoma?
A: Every 1–2 years. North-facing slopes and homes near trees may need annual cleaning to prevent moss damage.

Q: What type of fence works best in Tacoma's climate?
A: Western red cedar is most popular — naturally rot-resistant and handles moisture well. Vinyl is zero-maintenance. All posts set in concrete at 24-inch minimum depth.

Q: How much does a bathroom remodel cost?
A: Basic update: $8,000–$12,000. Mid-range remodel: $12,000–$18,000. Full gut remodel: $18,000–$25,000+.

Q: What roofing materials do you recommend for Pierce County?
A: Architectural asphalt shingles from CertainTeed, GAF, or Owens Corning. Best balance of durability, wind resistance (130+ mph), and value for Pacific Northwest climate.

Q: Do you need a permit to build a deck in Pierce County?
A: Most decks over 200 sq ft or more than 30 inches above grade require a permit. Ark handles permit applications and ensures code compliance.
